en: Sepia-toned interior photograph of an early 20th‑century public building, likely a bank or post office. The image shows a long corridor with tiled geometric flooring, tall white columns, hanging pendant lamps, and a continuous dark wooden counter with wire-mesh screens separating staff from the public. At the far end there are small signs above the counter windows. A faint circular stamp impression is visible in the lower left corner and a small printed mark in the lower right.
